generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civil engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing kpp Portal.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents Contractors Should be registered with KPWD as Class-IV& above Contractor and further orders thereon.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work. The tenderer should maintain the Road/Bridge/ Culvert/Building works during the defective liability period for 1 years.

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given in clause 24.1 of ITT for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security deposit for unbalanced tenders in accordance with clause 24.3 of ITT and clause 44 of the conditions of contract for all works.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to any adjacent structures/utilities above or below the ground and also to the existing canal CD works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost. Damage to physical property and personal injury and death will be the personal risk of the contractor.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost.

For SC & ST Contractors :- As per G.O.No.FD 876 EXP-12/2017, Bangalore Dt:10-10- 2017 Security Deposit for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of 1st & Final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final bill. (If applicable)
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division, Chickaballapur during office hours on all working days.

Materials like bitumen or steel,cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work at their own cost.

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts,loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, cost and convenience of all materials and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detalied technical specification and direction of Engineer - in charge of this work.

Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act & the contractor should employ only registered labours as per Govt. Circular No. PWD/198/BMS/2009/ Dated: 24-06-2009, negative tenders for labour portion will be rejected. (If applicable)

Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt. orders. As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

The returns submitted to the I.T. along with the Profit and Loss account statement, Balance sheet should be uploaded for the financial turnover criteria attested by registered Chartered Accountant, along with UDIN and balance sheets else will be treated as invalid.
Participating agencies should compulsorily possess GST and PAN numbers. GST number should be valid and in force at the time of participation.

As per Government circular no: FD 355 EXP-12/2024 dtd:01.08.2024, Letter of Intent (LoI) will be issued in Karnataka Public Procurement Portal 2.0 software, contractor has to accept LOI online and submit the BGs through KPP portal within 07 days. if not, tender will be rejected as per Guidelines.

itemList.description:
Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: PIPE CULVERTS - Providing and Laying Reinforced Cement Concrete Pipe NP3 as per design in Single Row - Providing and laying reinforced cement concrete pipe NP3 for  culverts  on  first  class  bedding  of  granular   material  in single row including   fixing collar with cement mortar 1:2 but   excluding   excavation,   protection   works,   backfilling, concrete  and  masonry  works  in  head  walls  and  parapets Clause 1101.6. - 1200mm dia. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1101.6 ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Providing  and  laying  in  Cement  Concrete    for  all  Basement  &  surface  level works,  return  walls,  retaining  walls,  sunken  floors  etc.  The    granite/trap/ basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle  vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all   other   appurtenances    required to complete the work as per technical  specifications. - M 25   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Manual Means -
Refilling   available   earth   around   trenches/pipelines,   cables   in   layers   not exceeding 20 cms in depth, compacting Each deposited layer by ramming after watering with a lead upto 50 m, and lift upto 1.5 m. Including cost of all labour complete as per specifications ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

itemList.description: Painting Two Coats on New Concrete Surfaces - Painting  two  coats  after  filling  the  surface  with  synthetic enamel paint in all shades on new plastered concrete surfaces. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 803 ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

itemList.description: Granular Sub-Base - Plant Mix Method - Construction   of   Granular   Sub-Base   of   required   grading   as per  design  mixing  in  a  mechanical  mix  plant  at  OMC,  carriage of  mixed  Material  to  work  site,  spreading  in  uniform  layers with  motor  grader  on  prepared  surface  and  compacting  with vibratory power roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 - For Grading -V Material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 401 ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

The superplastisiser  confirming  to  IS  9103-1999  Reaffirmed-2008,Coarse aggregates and Fine aggregate confirming to IS:383-2016, transported to site, laid in approved fixed side form work (steel channel,  laying  and  fixing  of  125  micron  thick  polythene  film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the form work). (Groove cutting shall be paid seperately) ---- including the cost and conveyance of all materials, Curing, cost of labour hire charges of equipment and machinery, all lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete the work shall be carried out as per standard technical specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
